mapper.sql: t.id, COALESCE(tt.title, t.title) AS title, COALESCE(tt.description, t.description) AS description, t.category_id, COALESCE(ct.name, c.name) AS category_name, t.kind, t.cover_path, t.required_image_count, t.accepted_mime_types, t.render_spec, t.effect_tags, t.output_kind, t.max_file_size_bytes, t.canvas_width, t.canvas_height, t.sort_order
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, COALESCE(ct.name, c.name) AS name, c.sort_order FROM template_category c LEFT JOIN template_category_translation ct ON ct.category_id = c.id AND ct.locale = #{locale} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
